technology: Small UAS for imagery, thermal and survey
what_is_automated: Flight path execution, obstacle avoidance, image capture on grid; increasingly photogrammetric processing
what_is_augmented: Coverage of dangerous or large areas; thermal detection; repeat imagery
new_field_tasks: Mission planning around airspace, wildlife and crews; ground control and check points; airworthiness and battery management; abnormal-event handling; data hand-off QA
irreducibly_human: Site hazard reading; deciding whether the data answer the field question; coordinating with crews and air operations; interpreting what imagery cannot show (understory, soil, sign)
adoption_status: Scaled in USFS (4,536 flight hours FY24; 342 aircraft; 371 pilots, 99% collateral duty); collapsed then partially recovered in DOI after 2019-20 grounding
adoption_evidence: FC-002: FY24 hours +78% over FY23; FC-001: BLM flights 3,643 (2019) to 528 (2023)
barriers: Federal procurement restrictions (ASDA from Dec 2025; FCC Covered List Dec 2025; 2026 proposal on already-authorized models); cost (DOI avg drone >$15k vs ~$2.6k earlier); pilot currency (73% compliant); airworthiness standards immature

technology: UAS aerial ignition (prescribed and wildland fire)
what_is_automated: Dispensing of ignition spheres along programmed or piloted lines
what_is_augmented: Ignition in terrain unsafe for crews; replaces some helicopter ignition
new_field_tasks: UAS ignition system operator under the firing boss; integrated ignition sequencing across hand, drone and aerial; drone-specific hazard controls
irreducibly_human: Firing boss and burn boss judgment on pattern, holding capacity, go/no-go; holding crews; reading fire behavior
adoption_status: Scaled: 188,986 acres ignited by UAS in FY24 (USFS); ~855 ignition flight hours
adoption_evidence: FC-002; FC-010 says UAS has been replacing helicopters for ignition; FC-001: DOI shifted some ignition back to helicopters under drone restrictions
barriers: Compliant aircraft cost (~$52k to ~$86k per ignition drone); 1.5-3 years to train operators; policy reversals

what_is_automated: Long-range autonomous flight; one supervisor over several aircraft
what_is_augmented: Corridor inspection, large-area surveys, agricultural operations
new_field_tasks: Operations supervisor and flight coordinator roles; organizational training programs; safety management systems
irreducibly_human: Accountability for safe operation; abort decisions; integration with ground work
adoption_status: Not yet in force: NPRM Aug 2025; final rule at OIRA July 2026; publication after that not verified
barriers: Rule timing; TSA security assessments; organizational SMS burden

technology: Lidar (airborne, drone, terrestrial, mobile including phone-based) and photogrammetry
what_is_automated: Tree height, canopy, terrain and structure metrics over large areas
what_is_augmented: Inventory, fuels, hydrology and channel mapping; fewer plots per estimate
new_field_tasks: Calibration plots; deciding where field plots are still needed; field validation of derived metrics; ground control
irreducibly_human: Species, defect, decay, regeneration under canopy, soil; judging where remote metrics fail (multi-storied, steep, recently disturbed)
adoption_status: Widespread in agencies and industry for terrain and canopy; operational lidar-assisted inventory growing (adoption figures not verified)
adoption_evidence: FC-032 (v1 forester PD analysis); national lidar program FC-056 not accessed
barriers: Data processing capacity; cost of repeat acquisition; staff who can link plots to models

what_is_automated: Laboratory detection of many taxa from one sample; increasingly autosamplers
what_is_augmented: Detection of rare, cryptic or invasive species; broad biodiversity surveys
new_field_tasks: Contamination-controlled sampling; site, timing and replication design; field blanks; confirmation surveys after detections
irreducibly_human: Field contamination control; interpreting a detection in the context of flow, transport and site; deciding when to confirm in person
adoption_status: Growing in agencies and consultancies; standardization still in progress (federal strategy 2024 not verified this session)
barriers: Lack of standard methods and reporting; lab turnaround; regulatory acceptance of detections

technology: Passive acoustic monitoring with AI classifiers
what_is_automated: Continuous recording; species call detection and classification
what_is_augmented: Survey coverage across seasons and nights; rare-species detection
new_field_tasks: Recorder siting, deployment, servicing, theft and weather management; detection review and verification
irreducibly_human: Expert verification of classifier outputs; siting judgment; field follow-up on management-relevant detections
adoption_status: Scaled for some programs (northern spotted owl monitoring reported to have moved to PAM; not verified this session)
barriers: Data volume and storage; classifier performance on local dialects and rare calls; staff to verify

technology: Camera traps with AI image triage
what_is_automated: Removal of blank images; species suggestions; counts
new_field_tasks: Deployment design and servicing; verifying AI labels; managing theft, damage and privacy (people in images)
irreducibly_human: Expert verification of difficult species and individuals; study design; interpretation
adoption_status: Widely used by NGOs, academia and agencies; AI triage common (scale not verified)
barriers: Privacy and human-image handling; model bias toward well-represented regions; data platforms

technology: Mobile data collection (tablet and phone forms, offline maps)
what_is_automated: Data entry validation, location capture, sync
new_field_tasks: Form design with field users; offline and device-failure procedures; field QA of entries
irreducibly_human: Observation itself; protocol fidelity; noticing what the form does not ask
adoption_status: Standard practice in most agencies, consultancies and NGOs
adoption_evidence: FC-027 (v1 notes Survey123/Field Maps/Fulcrum/ODK as deployed standard)
barriers: Connectivity; device ruggedness; enterprise data systems; FedRAMP/security approvals for cloud apps

technology: Continuous in-situ sensors and telemetry (water, soil, weather)
what_is_automated: Measurement and transmission at high frequency; automated QC flags
what_is_augmented: Event capture (storms, spills), trend detection, early warning
new_field_tasks: Sensor siting, installation, calibration, fouling and drift management, security, side-by-side checks, decommissioning
irreducibly_human: Recognizing when data are wrong for physical reasons; deciding when to visit and sample manually
adoption_status: Expanding (federal next-generation water observing build-out not verified this session); common in utilities
barriers: Power, connectivity, vandalism, maintenance budgets often omitted from capital grants

technology: Low-cost air sensors and community monitoring networks
what_is_automated: Continuous PM and gas measurement; correction algorithms
what_is_augmented: Spatial density beyond regulatory monitors; smoke events
new_field_tasks: Colocation with reference monitors; siting; maintenance; community network support
irreducibly_human: Judging data fitness for decisions; working with communities who host sensors
adoption_status: Mainstreamed in public smoke maps with correction (EPA; not verified this session)
barriers: Sensor drift; correction for humidity; data governance with communities

technology: Satellite products (optical, SAR, thermal, evapotranspiration, burn severity)
what_is_automated: Change detection, burn severity, water extent, ET estimates at landscape scale
new_field_tasks: Ground-truthing and accuracy assessment; cause coding of mismatches; field verification before regulatory use
irreducibly_human: Verifying on the ground; seeing below canopy and below surface; site history
adoption_status: Scaled practice for fire (BAER burn severity) and mapping
barriers: Accuracy in heterogeneous terrain; revisit times; trust and regulatory acceptance

what_is_automated: Seed or seed-pod dispersal over large or steep areas
new_field_tasks: Site preparation decisions; establishment monitoring plots; comparing drone vs crew planting outcomes
irreducibly_human: Microsite selection; seedling handling; competing vegetation and browse management
adoption_status: Pilots and commercial offerings; establishment evidence not verified
barriers: Establishment rates; seed supply; cost per surviving tree

technology: Autonomous, teleoperated and assisted heavy equipment (machine control, winch-assist steep-slope harvesting, remote-controlled masticators)
what_is_automated: Grade control; boom functions; machine positioning
what_is_augmented: Safety on steep slopes; precision earthwork for restoration
new_field_tasks: Supervising automation; setting and checking machine-control models in the field; new hazard controls around remote machines
irreducibly_human: Reading terrain, soil and water response during work; stop decisions
adoption_status: Adoption in forestry and construction growing; in ecological restoration not verified (v1 flagged Ro-pending)
barriers: Cost; contractor capacity; operator training; terrain

technology: Firefighting robots and autonomous suppression concepts (swarms, ground robots)
what_is_automated: Concept stage for wildland: water/retardant delivery, perimeter tracking
new_field_tasks: If adopted: supervision, airspace and ground deconfliction
adoption_status: Horizon signal; FAA single-aircraft limits block swarms until rules change

what_is_automated: Overlay of boundaries, plots, buried utilities, past conditions
new_field_tasks: Field verification of overlay accuracy; device management
irreducibly_human: Reading the actual site; noticing what the overlay omits
adoption_status: Limited in environmental field work (v1 2.7.1); adoption evidence not found
barriers: Battery, glare, ruggedness, positional accuracy under canopy

technology: AI field assistants (image and sound ID apps, LLM assistants for protocols and safety)
what_is_automated: Species suggestions; protocol lookups; draft JHAs and reports
what_is_augmented: Speed for novices; reference access offline
new_field_tasks: Verifying suggestions; documenting reliance; teaching novices when not to trust the tool
irreducibly_human: Final identification and safety calls; noticing implausible suggestions
adoption_status: Image/sound ID apps are widely used; LLM field assistants early (no adoption evidence found)
adoption_evidence: FC-053; FC-027 (v1 4.4.1 T1 note on AI-drafted JHAs)
barriers: Offline operation; accuracy on rare or local taxa; risk that novices stop forming judgment

technology: Precision agriculture auto-steer, variable-rate and spray drones
new_field_tasks: Supervising automated passes; validating prescriptions against field conditions; calibration
irreducibly_human: Agronomic reading of crop, soil and pest conditions; anomaly response
adoption_evidence: FC-027; FC-008 (spray drones affected by FCC proposal)
barriers: Equipment cost; spray drone supply under FCC actions

technology: Utility vegetation risk analytics (satellite and lidar span scoring)
what_is_automated: Risk scoring and prioritization of spans
new_field_tasks: Field verification and override of scores; documenting overrides for model feedback
irreducibly_human: Tree risk assessment on site; landowner contact; work-crew safety
adoption_status: Operational at large utilities (scale not verified)
barriers: Model transparency; regulator acceptance; data on outcomes
